subject.title: [Feature]: Guided CLI onboarding with live AI verification (macOS parity) and classic fallback

question: Should default interactive CLI onboarding switch from chat-first setup to a deterministic guided verifier that reuses detectSetupInference/activateSetupInference, while preserving classic and non-interactive contracts?
rationale: The verified engine exists, but changing the default first-run CLI UX and fallback ladder is a product/API compatibility choice, and the live issue has the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Adopt guided verifier as CLI default
options.body: Use the structured setup inference engine for default interactive CLI onboarding and keep Crestodian chat, classic wizard, and skip setup as explicit escape hatches.

options.title: Narrow to verification only
options.body: Live-test the detected model before persistence without adding manual key entry or a new guided flow.

options.title: Keep chat-first onboarding
options.body: Leave the current conversational setup default and accept that first live model failure happens after setup unless a separate recovery path is added.

recommendation.title: Adopt guided verifier as CLI default
recommendation.body: Use the structured setup inference engine for default interactive CLI onboarding and keep Crestodian chat, classic wizard, and skip setup as explicit escape hatches.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current onboarding surfaces and the verified setup engine this issue proposes reusing for CLI.
